name: safari-trails
description: Safari Trails — a travel tour booking platform. Node + TypeScript API, Supabase Postgres, React + TypeScript web, Vercel deploy.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=api & npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=api && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=api && npm run typecheck --workspace=web
